raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the section's deliverable is that a disposal naming a review run whose record is filed in the reviewed run's directory but absent from the project's review store is refused saying so and carrying the promoting command; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1208-1226 adds a fall-through to that filed copy in the `--review` branch and emits `_unpromoted_named_review_refusal`, which names the state and composes the promoting command through `_promotion_command`.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_disposal_names_an_unpromoted_review.py with three arms; the manifest records the scoped gate at 534ee5f9c3 (61 passed), the baseline arm at 4a5ec5081e3 (58 passed) and the after arm at 534ee5f9c3 (61 passed), each log carrying its revision, the literal command and a closing `EXIT=0`; the declared negative control at 4a5ec5081e3 shows the first arm failing with the no-record refusal (2 failed, 1 passed, `EXIT=1`), and I re-ran the named file once at the reviewed head (3 passed in 1.14s).
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew_run_commands.py, reckon/crew/review_records.py, tests/test_a_disposal_names_an_unpromoted_review.py plus a docs evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff adds to the first three only, and no undeclared file changes.
VERDICT manifest: read; it claims status complete, names the three changed paths, records the scoped gate 61 passed and both suite arms 58/61 with no failure ids, cites the negative-control log, and its evidence_inputs quote the new refusal text and its single composition through `_promotion_command`.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 4a5ec5081e3; one commit (534ee5f9c3) adds `filed_unpromoted_review_record` (review_records.py +40), `_unpromoted_named_review_refusal` and the dispose fall-through (crew_run_commands.py +50), and a 260-line test file; the change is additive and leaves the existing no-record refusal intact.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:crew_dispose (the `crew dispose --review` path), reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:_promotion_command (composed for the offered remedy), reckon/crew/review.py:run_review_record_directory
SCORE goal_fidelity: 17
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1208-1226 refuses with the right diagnosis in the live-pointer case, but reckon/crew_run_commands.py:946-957 composes "reckon crew observe --run <review>" when the review run's pointer is gone while the sentence still says "Promote that review run first".
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the gate log at 534ee5f9c3 records 61 passed with a closing EXIT=0, and the negative-control.log first arm fails at 4a5ec5081e3 on the no-record refusal, so the measure is shown to fail before the change.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: the diff's three paths are exactly three of the declared write paths in the manifest, and nothing outside them changed.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: removing the fall-through at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1215 reddens both new arms, as negative-control.log shows at the base revision, though tests/test_a_disposal_names_an_unpromoted_review.py:241 asserts an echo of the `--node` value the test itself passed in. 
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: `_unpromoted_named_review_refusal` sits beside `_no_named_review_record_refusal` in reckon/crew_run_commands.py and reuses `_promotion_command` as reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:2399 and reckon/crew/obligations.py:1013 already do.
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/review_records.py:2903 re-implements the record-selection loop that reckon/crew/review.py:4171 `_records_named_this_review` already owns rather than calling it.
FINDING reckon/crew/review_records.py:2903 non-blocking: `filed_unpromoted_review_record` duplicates the capability `_records_naming_this_review` at reckon/crew/review.py:4171 already owns (iterating `run_review_record_directory(...).glob("*.json")`, parsing each, and requiring both `review_run_id` and `reviewed_run_id` to match) instead of extending or wrapping it; the copy also drops the owner's optional rubric filter, so a `--rubric`-qualified lookup can be told "not yet promoted" by a record of another rubric.
FINDING tests/test_a_disposal_names_an_unpromoted_review.py:241 non-blocking: `assert receipt["disposition"] == f"folded:{FOLD_NODE}"` compares the receipt against the very `--node` value the test passed on the command line, so it moves with the input rather than with an independent source and would not catch a receipt that echoed the wrong node back; the arm's real guard is the `exit_code == 0` assertion beside it.
FINDING reckon/crew_run_commands.py:948 non-blocking: when the named review run has no readable pointer, `read_pointer` raises and the code passes `{}` to `_promotion_command`, which returns `reckon crew observe --run <review>` (probed at 534ee5f9c3 with an absent pointer), so the refusal says "Promote that review run first:" and then names a command that does not promote it.
